comment: Third-party OpenSCAD libraries vendored into the build sandbox and placed on
OPENSCADPATH, so that `include <BOSL2/std.scad>` resolves in an isolated build.
Everything here is pinned to an immutable commit, never a branch: the geometry a
part produces depends on these, so a floating ref would silently change published
parts. The set's digest is folded into every build hash, which means bumping a
library correctly invalidates the artifact cache rather than serving stale
Licences are recorded and each library's own LICENSE file is kept in the image.
Keep this set small and well-known; it is not a general package manager, and a
part needing something exotic should publish it among its own files.

libraries.name: BOSL2
libraries.why: By far the most used OpenSCAD library, and the most common unresolved include in the supply audit.

libraries.name: Round-Anything
libraries.why: Widely used for filleting, which functional printed parts need constantly.

libraries.name: MCAD
libraries.why: The historic bundled library; older parts assume it is installed.
